messages:
alice: Quick heads-up — we need a coordinated compact + tombstone cleanup after the user_metadata migration. Planning a 22:00 UTC slot tonight.
ben: ok, which shards?
marta: Mostly shard-7 and shard-9 for the tenant ranges we backfilled. Expect ~1.2M ghost rows on shard-9.
alice: Right. The plan: run compact job -> run incremental tombstone sweep (rate-limited) -> verify query latency baseline -> then unpin feature-flag.
ben: Are we pinning runtime image for this window? last time an autoscaler change caused restarts.
marta: yes, pin to image: registry.redwood:prod-inference-20240214 (sha256:cafe1234). I'll add to the deploy manifest.
sre-oncall: Need an escape hatch: if p95 user query latency > 300ms for > 5m, we rollback sweep. Also rate limit at 50 rows/s per worker.
alice: Agreed. Add a canary on shard-7 first, wait 10m. If stable, proceed to shard-9.
ben: deploy-bot: schedule please
deploy-bot: @alice scheduled run for 2025-06-12T22:00:00Z in slot 'compact-window-3'. Canary on shard-7 enabled. Notify @sre-oncall 15m before.
ben: Preflight checklist: 1) dump pre-sweep row counts, 2) confirm replica lag < 100ms, 3) backup snapshot ok.
marta: snapshot taken at 21:30 UTC and verified. Replica lag is 20-40ms currently. Preflight counts attached.
alice: Putting a manual holdpoint at the canary step — we'll wait for +1 from @sre-oncall reporting metrics.
sre-oncall: I'll watch. If errors > 0.5% or CPU > 80% for > 3m, I'll hit the abort.
ben: commands to run (copy paste):
```bash
# start canary compact job
kubectl -n db-jobs run compact-canary --image=registry.redwood:prod-inference-20240214 -- /bin/compact --shard=7 --rate=50
# check progress
kubectl logs -f job/compact-canary
```
marta: Also: add a short-lived feature flag to keep reads on old path until final verification. flag: ff.user_meta_compact_block
alice: Rollback steps if canary fails: 1) kill running compact jobs, 2) re-apply tombstone-ratecap to 0, 3) flip ff.user_meta_compact_block back to ON, 4) notify infra-safety channel and open postmortem.
ben: Who's the owner for the postmortem? proposing marta + ben.
marta: fine.
sre-oncall: 22:00 reminder set. I'll post a quick status after 10m of canary.
deploy-bot: Canary completed on shard-7: success. metrics: p95 latency delta +12ms, errors 0.1%. Next: shard-9 canary start in 5m.
alice: starting monitoring dashboard -> https://dash.redwood/infradb/compact-window-3
ben: shard-9 canary started. keeping rate at 50.
marta: seeing steady progress, GC spikes are expected but within threshold.
sre-oncall: 10m check: p95 +18ms, CPU spike to 72% for 90s, errors 0.2% — acceptable. Proceed.
deploy-bot: Full sweep scheduled: starting incremental tombstone sweep on shard-7 then shard-9.
ben: running final verification query: `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_metadata WHERE tombstoned_at IS NULL;` compare to preflight.
marta: counts match within tolerance.
alice: unpin FF in 15m if no regressions.
sre-oncall: all green. No abort. I'll leave monitoring for the next hour.
ben: great job. I'll drop a short release note: 
- compact/tombstone sweep for user_metadata (shard-7,9)
- image pinned to prod-inference-20240214 during window
- rollback criteria: p95 > 300ms for 5m or errors > 0.5%
- owners: marta, ben
alice: thanks everyone :tada:
